name: Group Scheduled Transitions
description: Lets group members use Scheduled Transitions to schedule content moderation state changes within groups.
project_description:
The Group Scheduled Transitions module extends the Group module to support the Scheduled Transitions functionality.

 The code is developed based on issue #3219016. 

 This module adds Group support by adding view scheduled transitions and add scheduled transitions permissions. This is useful when you want certain group roles also to be able to schedule transitions.

 REQUIREMENTS 
 
 Scheduled Transitions 
 Group 
 
 RECOMMENDATIONS 
 This is not a requirement, but we strongly recommend also installing the Group Content Moderation module.

 INSTALLATION 
 The module can be installed via the standard Drupal installation process .

 CONFIGURATION 
 Go to the permissions page of your group types and set the new permissions

 view scheduled transitions and add scheduled transitions .
